description: This Java source file defines a custom Android InputMethodService called ThemedNavBarKeyboard that demonstrates integrating a software keyboard with custom themed navigation bars, including multiple modes for navigation bar appearance and behavior.

classes.name: ThemedNavBarKeyboard
classes.description: A custom InputMethodService for Android that demonstrates themed navigation bar integrations with multiple modes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the keyboard, disables navigation bar contrast enforcement on Android Q and above.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and returns the custom keyboard layout view.

methods.name: onComputeInsets
methods.description: Adjusts window insets for floating mode to avoid relayout issues.

inner_classes.name: BuildCompat
inner_classes.description: Utility class to determine effective SDK version based on release or dev build.

inner_classes.name: KeyboardLayoutView
inner_classes.description: Custom LinearLayout managing the keyboard's UI and navigation bar modes.

inner_classes.name: InputViewMode
inner_classes.description: Enum representing different input view modes: SYSTEM_OWNED_NAV_BAR_LAYOUT, IME_OWNED_NAV_BAR_LAYOUT, FLOATING_LAYOUT.

methods.name: switchToFloatingMode
methods.description: Switches the input view to floating mode, adjusting window flags and UI flags accordingly.

methods.name: switchToSeparateNavBarMode
methods.description: Configures the navigation bar to be controlled by the system with specified color and light/dark theme.

methods.name: switchToExtendedNavBarMode
methods.description: Configures the navigation bar to be transparent and allows the IME to control its appearance.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Helper to create a Button with specified label and click behavior.
